title: AIBOS-Installer
subtitle: Distribution {dist_line}
p1_1: You are installing AIbex AIBOS with the distribution {dist_line}.
p1_2: AIBOS fundamentally changes the behaviour of your AI (Claude Code), but only in the workspace you choose next: there it loads knowledge and rules into every session, provides commands (skills) and can assign assistants.
p1_3: Outside the workspace your AI behaves as without AIBOS.
p1_4: AIBOS writes to three places only: the folder ~/.aibos, your workspace and its own entries in ~/.claude/settings.json.
p1_5: Way back: ~/.aibos/bin/aibos --uninstall removes the entries in ~/.claude/settings.json. The folder ~/.aibos and your workspaces are kept; to remove everything, delete ~/.aibos afterwards.
p1_6: Nothing is installed before you agree on page 4.
p2_check: I have read the agreement and I accept it
p2_need_check: Please confirm with the checkbox that you accept.
p3_intro: A workspace is a folder whose name starts with §. AIBOS acts only there.
